WE NOW HAVE FULL ABILITY COMPENDIUMS!
WE NOW HAVE FULL ABILITY COMPENDIUMS!.text:
Hello! If you are upgrading from an older version of the INVESTIGATOR system, you may remember that we used to only have a subset of the abilities for each game setting, because we were restricted to what appeared in the GUMSHOE SRD.

Well, thanks to the good people at Pelgrane Press, we now have the full list, and all the abilities appear under their own names! 🎉

As a result, the following instructions are only here for people who want to add their own abilities:

How to add new abilities

  1. In the Items tab, create a new folder. Give it a name like "My Space Game Abilities" or whatever.

  2. Add abilities as follows:

    1. Click the button to create an item in the folder.
    2. Pick "Investigative Ability" or "General Ability"
    3. Configure the ability as needed.
    4. Repeat until you have all the additional abilities you need.
  3. Right-click the folder and Export to Compendium.
  4. Flip over to the Game Settings tab and click Open GUMSHOE System Settings.
  5. Under Abilities, go to PC Ability compendiums and put a tick (check) next to the name of your new compendium. Keep the built-in one ticked too if you're adding to its abilities, or untick it if you're replacing them.

Done! New PCs will now automatically be given the abilities in your new compendium. Also, if you create a party tracker, it will show those abilities in the list.
